entries.name: WP2 plug-in foundations
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 1.0 KB): the emit sites in main.ts and hud-combat.ts, the sending end of the event bus, the features loader with its one retry, bossApproach, and addPhrases in i18n.ts. The bus, the services and every feature load after Start.

entries.name: WP10 hero gait blend
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 0.3 KB): hero-motion.ts, the blend between the idle and the walk pose that runs from the first frame, in place of the switch in world.ts animatePlayer. The lean-in, the settle, the fidgets, the sit and the clips load after Start (features/hero-idle.ts).

entries.name: WP6 toy finish
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging at the merge (the plan's 0.3 KB was an estimate; it was 507 bytes against the staging WP6 was built on): the five colour steps, the ramp-colour shader patch and the icon/mirror swap in toon.ts, the neutral light steps under a cool sun, the ground colour correction and the gloss in look.ts, the look switch, and in crop-cards.ts (world chunk, loaded before Start) the bake at the camera pitch, the footprint cap, the centring of lopsided crops and the re-bake when the camera angle is changed. Two slimming passes saved about 50 bytes; the rest would mean cutting one of these.
